source.title: Android’s DIY widgets are a bit of vibe-coding fun
source.text: Widgets, your way. | Photo: Allison Johnson / The Verge Aside from dealing with my calendar , there's one thing I want AI to do: tell me if I'm about to miss the bus. What I need is a widget. It needs to tell me real-time arrivals for the bus stop near my house. Tapping around on my phone screen to open the right app and select my stop will slow me down enough to miss a bus. I need glanceable information, and I hoped that Android's vibe-coded widget feature could help me out here. It hasn't, to my disappointment, but I still had a good time cooking up other widgets.
